summary: Tested Invite Maker (Expo RN web preview) backend + frontend per review request. All 3 backend pytest cases passed (health, ai/suggest-text, ai/generate-background). Frontend critical path fully verified: Home heading 'Invite Studio', all 6 category pills, start-blank-btn, open-my-invites-btn, 4 template cards, editor navigation, canvas, all 4 toolbar tools, input-title->canvas update, background panel (pick-device-btn, ai-bg-btn, bg-option-0..3), color dots (color-#FFFFFF), AI text generation (title updated from backend to 'Maya's Wedding: A Celebration of Love'), save -> /preview/[id] with share/save-gallery/edit-from-preview/back-home buttons all present.

issues: RN web console warnings: 'shadow* style props deprecated' (use boxShadow), 'props.pointerEvents deprecated' (use style.pointerEvents), 'Image style.resizeMode deprecated' (use props.resizeMode). Cosmetic only — does not affect functionality.

action_items: (Optional) migrate deprecated style props (shadow*, pointerEvents, resizeMode) to silence RN web warnings.

(Minor) my-invites-list visibility check at end of E2E hit a transient 'not visible' after preview->back-home; functional flow up to that point validated. open-my-invites-btn IS visible on initial home load. No code change needed.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py: `logger` is referenced inside except blocks but defined at the very bottom of the file (after the routes/include_router). Currently works because logger is resolved at exception time (module-level by then), but it's bad ordering — move logger setup above the routes.
Editor has two testIDs for the AI background button: 'ai-bg-btn' (in background panel) and 'ai-bg-btn-2' (in AI panel) — fine, but worth noting for consistency.
seed_data_creation: None — local-only storage; one invite created during E2E save flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses Emergent LLM key (gemini-2.5-flash for text, gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview for bg). Image gen takes ~15-20s — use 120s timeouts. Frontend served at EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL; mobile viewport 390x844. testIDs are exposed as data-testid in web build.
